name: agent-review-10-none-of-the-above
goal: An answer that is supposed to stand alone on a tick-box question, which the product cannot enforce.

messages.text: I want a one page survey for the council, called Marchfield Council contact survey. Ask how they got in touch with us and let them tick every way they used: by phone, by email, through the website, in person. Then a last answer for people who did not contact us at all. Anyone picking that last one must not be able to tick the others as well.

seed.requires: A dev database with no form titled Marchfield Council contact survey.
seed.fixtures: All data is invented: Marchfield Council is not a real council and no scenario sends a real person's details.

assistantMust: say, without being asked, that an answer which cannot be ticked alongside the others is not something the form can hold
build one of the two shapes and say which one it built: the single list with the standalone answer last, or the two questions that do carry the rule
where it builds the single list, say that the form will accept the standalone answer together with the others and that nothing flags it
where it builds the two questions, say in the council's own words what the first one now asks
put the question or questions and the form on one plan, and publish nothing

notes: The defect this came from is a form built with the standalone answer silently tickable alongside the others, and nothing said about it. Capping the number of answers at one is the wrong fix and a failure: it forbids two ordinary answers as well. Either shape passes as long as the reply says which one it built and what that shape does not stop; the option count is four because the split shape moves the standalone answer onto a question of its own.
